title.narrative: Support to ICARS for 1 January to 30 June, 2026, Global Action Against AMR

description.narrative:
- Ensure a gradual transition of ICARS from the Ministry of the Interior and Health (MoH) to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA), including the formulation of a new multi-year agreement with ICARS based on the new strategy for 2026 – 2030 - Contribution to the new ICARS strategy for 2026 – 2030, which will be published in May 2026. - Ensure the continuation and further development of ICARS programmes and activities, including the final implementation of the current ICARS strategy, until June 2026.
- The World Health Organisation estimates that bacterial AMR as directly responsible for 1,27 million global deaths in 2019 and contributed to 4,95 million deaths. -ICARS’s mandate and work is highly relevant for key Danish priorities and interests within global health. Denmark is committed to take part in efforts to strengthen global health at the local, national and global level alongside likeminded and multilateral partners, including the continued support to the mitigation of AMR in LMICs. - Denmark established ICARS in 2019 and there is a strong support from the Government to continue the support to the organisation. Continued Danish support to ICARS to ensure the transition from the MoH to MFA
